name: schedule
description: List and edit recurring agent runs in state/schedule.json. {"action":"list"} returns every entry with its next fire time plus the last 20 ledger records. {"action":"set_enabled","id":"sch-1","enabled":false} pauses one (re-enabling re-dates the window from now). {"action":"add","cron":"0 9 * * 1-5","task":"..."} schedules a task; optional provider, model, tz_offset_minutes. {"action":"update","id":"sch-1",...} edits an existing entry: pass any of cron, task, provider, model, tz_offset_minutes and only those fields change. {"action":"remove","id":"sch-1"} drops an entry (its ledger history stays). Nothing fires from this tool: the system's cron calls `clanker schedule run-due`.
llm_description: List/edit the cron schedule (state/schedule.json). actions: list, set_enabled{id,enabled}, add{cron,task,provider?,model?,tz_offset_minutes?}, update{id,cron?,task?,provider?,model?,tz_offset_minutes?}, remove{id}. Firing is `clanker schedule run-due`, not this tool.
